name: Chimera Tail
source:
In this game you play as Samuel, the tail of a particularly love struck Chimera, and you have to help your brothers, the other heads, win the girls of their dreams before having them help you do the same.

Created in 7 days for [url=http://itch.io/jam/monster-mash]#monstermash2014[/url].

[From [url=http://marionette.itch.io/chimeratail]official site[/url]]
translation:
本作中，你将扮演萨缪尔——一只特别爱上某人的奇美拉的尾巴。你要帮助其他脑袋、也就是你的兄弟们赢得梦中女孩的芳心，然后让她们帮你完成同样的事。

用7天为[url=http://itch.io/jam/monster-mash]#monstermash2014[/url]制作。

[译自[url=http://marionette.itch.io/chimeratail]官方网站[/url]]
